name: inbox-triage
title_zh: 收件箱里哪些必须回、哪些直接归档，它替你分好
tagline_zh: 打开邮箱不再从第一封读起。它先挑出等你回话的，把通知、促销、已读回执扫进归档，要回信时还能先起个草稿。
tagline_en: No more reading from the top. It surfaces what awaits your reply, archives the noise, and drafts responses when.
desc_en: Triage the user's email inbox — surface what needs replies, archive the noise, draft responses on request. Use for "check my email", "what's in my inbox", "clean up my inbox", or scheduled inbox sweeps.
why_zh: 先判断「这封要不要你动手」，再决定归档还是起草，而不是按发件人一刀切。
why_en: It decides whether a mail needs you before archiving or drafting, instead of filtering by sender alone.
limit_zh: 只处理已接入的邮箱账户，没配 IMAP 或 API 的收件箱它读不到；草稿只写不自动发送，归档动作需你确认。
limit_en: Works only on connected accounts; no IMAP/API means no access. Drafts are never auto-sent, archiving needs your OK, and attachments or encrypted.
title_en: Sorts your inbox into must-reply and archive
